title: Signal Map — Lightweight Product Analytics Dashboard
summary: A fast, human-friendly dashboard that turns raw events into clear product signals for weekly decision-making.
problem: Teams were debating priorities based on anecdotes. Data existed, but it was scattered and too slow to interpret during weekly meetings.
approach: Defined a small set of actionable metrics, designed a single-page dashboard with opinionated defaults, and set up a simple refresh pipeline so weekly reviews start with consistent numbers.
outcome: Shifted weekly conversations from gathering data to making decisions by aligning the team around a shared set of signals.
